text: During the O’Connor Drive Road Resurfacing in the summer of 2015, a guiderail at the northwest corner of the curve at O'Connor Drive and Broadview Avenue was removed and it was not re-installed. Local residents have since raised safety concerns about this corner and would like the guiderail re-installed. This matter has been brought to the attention of the General Manager, Transportation Services and no report has been provided as to why this guiderail should not be installed. If there are any reasons this guiderail should not be re-installed, any concerns about the use of guiderails in such a manner or AODA concerns then those concerns should be reported to Toronto and East York Community Council.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services to re-install the guiderail at the northwest corner of the curve at O'Connor Drive and Broadview Avenue. 2. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services report back to Toronto and East York Community Council if there are safety concerns that prevent this installation.
